name: Taming the Beast
label: Quest
description: Quel'ana Quickgale in Valanaar can teach you to tame a beast. Your time in the highlands has prepared you to seek an animal companion.
intro: Quel'ana Quickgale in Valanaar can teach you to tame a beast. Your time in the highlands has prepared you to seek an animal companion.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Now that you've gained a level of comfort in the wilds of the highlands, I believe it is time for you to seek your very own animal companion.
Go to the port of Valanaar to the southeast, and speak with Quel'ana Quickgale there. He will instruct you in the art of beast taming.

clips.title: Completion
paras: I am most glad that you came. Come, let us begin.
